summary: NBC 5 Dallas-Fort Worth reports on proposed federal legislation that would ban companies from using artificial intelligence to set prices based on customers personal data, in the context of Delta expanding AI-based revenue management. The article says NBC checked with American and Southwest about their plans, and Southwest told NBC 5 that it does not use AI in its pricing models.
